title: Value attained by a repeated interval average
statement: Let $\eta>0$ and let $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be continuous. For every natural number $m$ and every real $x$, there is a point $y\in[x,x+m\eta]$ such that $S_\eta^m\psi(x)=\psi(y)$.
